content.hebrew: בְּהַנְחֵ֤ל עֶלְיוֹן֙ גּוֹיִ֔ם בְּהַפְרִיד֖וֹ בְּנֵ֣י אָדָ֑ם יַצֵּב֙ גְּבֻלֹ֣ת עַמִּ֔ים לְמִסְפַּ֖ר בְּנֵ֥י יִשְׂרָאֵֽל: (דברים לב:ז)
content.transliteration: Behanḥel ‘elyon goyim behafrido benē adam yats’tsev gevult ‘ammim lemispar benē Yisra’el:
content.english: When the One on high gave inheritances to the nations, when he separated people [into nations]; he set the borders of peoples in accordance with the number of the sons of Israel. (Deut. 32:7)

content.hebrew: אַתָּה הִצַּֽבְתָּ גְּבֻלֹת עַמִּים לְמִסְפַּר בְּנֵי יִשְׂרָאֵל וְתוֹלְדֹתָם;
content.transliteration: Atta hits’tsavta gevulot ‘ammim lemispar benē Yirsa’el vetoledotam;
content.english: You set the borders of peoples in accordance with the number of the sons of Israel and their descendants;

content.hebrew: הַמֵּעִיר רֽוּחַ יַעֲקֹב, לֵאמֹר לְבָנָיו רֵאשִׁיתָם וְאַחֲרִיתָם.
content.transliteration: Hamme‘ir ru’aḥ Ya‘aḳov, lemor levanav reshitam ve’aḥaritam.
content.english: [You who] roused Jacob’s spirit to tell his sons their beginnings and endings.

content.hebrew: דִּבְרֵי חֵן בְּמַעֲבֵה הַנְּבוּאָה, יְצוּקִים בִּמְלִיצָתָם –
content.transliteration: Divrē ḥen bema‘avē hannevu’a, yetsuḳim bimlitsatam –
content.english: [Jacob’s] graceful words [were] thick with prophecy, well founded in their locution—

content.hebrew: קהל: וְזֹאת אֲשֶׁר דִּבֶּר לָהֶם אֲבִיהֶם וַיְבָֽרֶךְ אוֹתָם, אִישׁ אֲשֶׁר כְּבִרְכָתוֹ בֵּרַךְ אֹתָם.        (בראשית מט:כח)
content.transliteration: Ḳahal: Vezot asher dibber lahem avihem vayvarekh otam, ish asher kevirkhato berakh otam:
content.english: Cong. And this is what their father said to them, and he blessed them; he blessed each man in accordance with his [particular] blessing.    (Gen. 49:28)

content.hebrew: הוֹכִֽיחַ רְאוּבֵן וְקִבֵּל, וַיַּֽעַל עַל מִבְצְרֵי מְזִמּוֹת רָמוֹת,
content.transliteration: Hokhi’aḥ Re’uven veḳibbel, vayya‘al ‘al mivtserē mezimmot ramot,
content.english: He rebuked Reuben, and he accepted, and ascended the fortresses of lofty thoughts.

content.hebrew: וַיִּטֹּשׁ בְּכוֹרָה מַלְכוּת וּכְהֻנָּה, לְהַחֲלִיץ הָעֲצָמוֹת,
content.transliteration: Vayyittosh bekhora malkhut ukhehunna, lehaḥalits ha‘atsamot,
content.english: He gave up the birthright, the kingship, and the priesthood, in order to strengthen [his] essence,

content.hebrew: לְמַֽעַן הֱיוֹת נִשְׁמָתוֹ צְרוּרָה בִּצְרוֹר חַיֵּי הַנְּשָׁמוֹת –
content.transliteration: Lema‘an heyot nishmato tserura bitsror ḥayyē hanneshamot –
content.english: So that his soul be bound up in the bundle of the life of souls—

content.hebrew: קהל: יְחִי רְאוּבֵן וְאַל יָמֹת.       (דברים לג:ו)
content.transliteration: Ḳahal: Yeḥi Re’uven ve’al yamot
content.english: Cong. May Reuben live, and not die!     (Deut. 33:6)

content.hebrew: רָאָה לְהָפִיץ שִׁמְעוֹן וְלֵוִי בֵּינוֹת יִשְׂרָאֵל, בְּאַהֲבָה,
content.transliteration: Ra’a lehafits Shim‘on veLevi benot Yisra’el be’ahava,
content.english: He saw fit to disperse Simeon and Levi amongst Israel, out of love,

content.hebrew: כִּי לִבָּם כַּיָּם סֹעֵר, וּכְאֵשׁ בֹּעֵר לֶהָבָה.
content.transliteration: Ki libbam kayyam so‘er, ukh’esh bo‘er lehava.
content.english: For their heart raged like the sea, and burned like an inferno.

content.hebrew: אֲחֵי עֵצָה קְצוּבָה, וַחֲלוּצֵי צָבָא,
content.transliteration: Aḥē ‘etsa ḳetsuva, vaḥalutsē tsava,
content.english: Brothers in their decisive counsel, and first into the fray,

content.hebrew: קהל: יִרְדֹּף אֶחָד אֶֽלֶף, וּשְׁנַֽיִם יָנִֽיסוּ רְבָבָה.   (דברים לב:ל)
content.transliteration: Ḳahal: Yirdof eḥad elef, ushnayim yanisu revava.
content.english: Cong. One could chase a thousand [men], and two could rout a myriad. (Deut. 32:30)

content.hebrew: נֶחְמָד בְּנֹֽעַם הֶגְיוֹנוֹ וְקוֹל דְּבָרוֹ,
content.transliteration: Neḥmad beno‘am heḡyono veḳol devaro,
content.english: Pleasing in his mellifluous speech, and the tone of his words,

content.hebrew: יְהוּדָה – יוֹדֽוּהוּ אֶחָיו: "זֶה אֲשֶׁר בְּחָרוֹ צוּרוֹ."
content.transliteration: Yehuda – yoduhu eḥav: “Zē asher beḥaro tsuro.”
content.english: Judah—his brothers acknowledge him: “This is the one whose Rock has chosen him.”

content.hebrew: עַד עֵת בֹּא דְבָרוֹ, אָז יִגָּלֶה אוֹרוֹ,
content.transliteration: ‘ad ‘et bo devaro, az yiggalē oro,
content.english: Until the prophecy about him is realized, then his light will be revealed,

content.hebrew: קהל: אִישׁ אֲשֶׁר הַמֶּֽלֶךְ חָפֵץ בִּיקָרוֹ.    (אסתר ו:ז)
content.transliteration: Ḳahal: Ish asher hammelekh ḥafets biḳaro.
content.english: Cong. The man whom the king wants to honor.   (Esth. 6:7)

content.hebrew: בְּחִיר אֵל, זְבוּלֻן, הַמַּחֲזִיק חֶֽרֶב וְכִידוֹן,
content.transliteration: Beḥir el, Zevulun, hammaḥaziḳ ḥerev vekhidon,
content.english: God’s chosen one, Zebulun, who brandishes sword and spear,

content.hebrew: לַעֲקֹר בּוֹ אִישׁ רִיב וְאִישׁ מָדוֹן,
content.transliteration: La‘aḳor bo ish riv ve’ish madon,
content.english: With which to uproot any opponent or combatant,

content.hebrew: חֵרֵף נַפְשׁוֹ לָמוּת, לְבַל יִשְׁלֹט בּוֹ אִישׁ זָדוֹן –
content.transliteration: Ḥeref nafsho lamut leval yishlot bo ish zadon –
content.english: Spurns his own life, to die, lest any wicked man have dominion over him—

content.hebrew: קהל: וְהוּא לְחוֹף אֳנִיּוֹת וְיַרְכָתוֹ עַל צִידוֹן.   (בראשית מט:יג)
content.transliteration: Ḳahal: Vehu leḥof oniyyot veyarkhato ‘al tsidon.
content.english: Cong. And he [dwells] at the docks, and his border is at Sidon. (Gen. 49:13)

content.hebrew: נָטָה יִשָּׂשכָר שִׁכְמוֹ לִסְבֹּל, וְלָן בֵּין שְׁפַתָּֽיִם,
content.transliteration: Natah Yissakhar shikhmo lisbol, velan ben shefattayim,
content.english: Issachar lowered his shoulder to carry a burden, and dwelled between the stoves,

content.hebrew: כִּי רָאָה הָאָֽרֶץ אֶֽרֶץ רַחֲבַת יָדָֽיִם.
content.transliteration: Ki ra’a ha’arets erets raḥavat yadayim.
content.english: For he saw that the Land was expansive.

content.hebrew: בָּחַר לָשֶֽׁבֶת בְּפֶֽתַח עֵינָיִם,
content.transliteration: Baḥar lashevet befetaḥ ‘enayim,
content.english: He chose to dwell in a place in public view,

content.hebrew: קהל: רֹבֵץ בֵּין הַמִּשְׁפְּתָֽיִם.      (בראשית מט:יד)
content.transliteration: Ḳahal: Rovets ben hammishpetayim:
content.english: Cong. Crouching between the stoves.     (Gen. 49:14)

content.hebrew: יָדִין דָּן עַמּוֹ, כְּאַחַד שִׁבְטֵי אֱמוּנָי,
content.transliteration: Yadin Dan ‘ammo ke’aḥad shivtē emunay,
content.english: Dan will judge his people, as one of the tribes of my faithful,

content.hebrew: וּמֵחֲלָצָיו יֵצֵא נְזִיר יוי,
content.transliteration: Umeḥalatsav yetsē nezir Adonai,
content.english: And from his loins will issue a Nazarite of Adonai,

content.hebrew: וְהוּא יָחֵל לְהוֹשִֽׁיעַ אֶת־יִשְׂרָאֵל מִיַּד מַשְׂטִינָי –
content.transliteration: Vehu yaḥel lehoshi’a‘ et Yisra’el miyyad mastinay
content.english: Who will begin to rescue Israel from the hand of My enemies—

content.hebrew: קהל: לִישׁוּעָתְךָ קִוִּֽיתִי יוי.      (בראשית מט:יח)
content.transliteration: Ḳahal: Lishu‘atekha ḳivviti Adonai.
content.english: Cong. I await Your rescue, O Adonai!     (Gen. 49:18)

content.hebrew: וּמִי יָגוּד לְגָד? וְגָד דְּבָרָיו לֹא יְסַלֵּף.
content.transliteration: Umi yaḡud leḠad? VeḠad devarav lo yesallef.
content.english: Who will amass against Gad? For Gad will not pervert his words.

content.hebrew: וְאֹיְבוֹ לְנֶגְדּוֹ מְקוֹם פָּנִים עֹֽרֶף יְחַלֵּף.
content.transliteration: Ve’oyevo leneḡdo meḳom panim ‘oref yeḥallef.
content.english: And his enemy, when facing him, will turn tail, exchanging face for nape.

content.hebrew: פָּנָיו כִּפְנֵי אַרְיֵה, בָּא לְמִלְחָמָה, בְּלִי שָׂכָר וְחֶֽלֶף.
content.transliteration: Panav kifnē aryē, ba lemilḥama, beli sakhar veḥelef.
content.english: His face is leonine; he goes to war, without any [expectation of] reward or compensation.

content.hebrew: קהל: אֵֽלֶּה מִבְּנֵי גָד רָאשֵׁי הַצָּבָא: אֶחָד לְמֵאָה הַקָּטֹן, וְהַגָּדוֹל לָאֶֽלֶף.       (דברי הימים א יב:טו)
content.transliteration: Ḳahal: Ellē mibbenē Ḡad rashē hats’tsava: Eḥad leme’a haḳḳaton, vehaggadol la’elef.
content.english: Cong. These are of the sons of Gad, military commanders—the junior for a hundred [men], and the senior for a thousand.    (1 Chr. 12:15)

content.hebrew: סְבִיבוֹת אָשֵׁר הוֹן וָעֹֽשֶׁר.
content.transliteration: Sevivot Asher hon va‘osher.
content.english: Asher will be surrounded by riches and wealth,

content.hebrew: צֶֽדֶק יָלִין בְּקִרְבּוֹ, תֹּם וָיֹֽשֶׁר.
content.transliteration: Tsedeḳ yalin beḳirbo, tov vayosher.
content.english: Righteousness will dwell in his midst, blamelessness and uprightness.

content.hebrew: שֶֽׁמֶן וּקְטֹֽרֶת בִּגְבוּלוֹ בְּכֹֽשֶׁר.
content.transliteration: Shemen uḳtoret biḡvulo bekhosher.
content.english: Oil and incense will fittingly be within his border,

content.hebrew: קהל: בָּרוּךְ מִבָּנִים אָשֵׁר.      (דברים לג:כד)
content.transliteration: Ḳahal: Barukh mibbanim Asher.
content.english: Cong. Blessed among sons is Asher.     (Deut. 33:24)

content.hebrew: פִּנַּת יִקְרַת, עֲשִׂירִי, אֶשְׁכֹּל הַכֹּֽפֶר,
content.transliteration: Pinnat yiḳrat ‘asiri, eshkol hakkofer,
content.english: The glorious cornerstone, the tenth [son], the cluster of henna,

content.hebrew: שְׂבַע רָצוֹן, וְעִם גִּבּוֹרֵי חַֽיִל יִסָּפֵר;
content.transliteration: Seva‘ ratson, ve‘im gibborē ḥayil yissafer;
content.english: Satiated with contentment, and numbered among the mighty warriors;

content.hebrew: נִצְחוֹן הַמִּלְחָמָה! יֹצֵא וָבָא וּמְסַפֵּר –
content.transliteration: Nits’ḥon hammilḥama! Yotsē vava umsapper –
content.english: Victory in battle! He will sally forth and return to tell [of his victories]—

content.hebrew: קהל: נַפְתָּלִי אַיָּלָה שְׁלֻחָה הַנֹּתֵן אִמְרֵי שָֽׁפֶר.   (בראשית מט:כא)
content.transliteration: Ḳahal: Naftali ayyala sheluḥa hannoten imrē shafer.
content.english: Cong. Naphtali is a fleety roe, who expresses beautiful words.  (Gen. 49:21)

content.hebrew: נִמְשָׁל בְּשׁוֹר, חָרֵד בִּדְבַר יוי וְחֶפְצוֹ,
content.transliteration: Nimshal beshor, ḥared bidvar Adonai veḥeftso,
content.english: The one compared to an ox, who reverentially obeyed Adonai’s word and will,
content.comments: The one compared to an ox. Joseph.

content.hebrew: כְּגֶֽפֶן פֹּרָת, [אָ]רְכוּ פֹארוֹתָיו עֲלֵי שׁוּר, לְאַמְּצוֹ.
content.transliteration: Keḡefen porat, arekhu forotav ‘alē shur, le’ammetso.
content.english: Like a fruitful vine, his tendrils extended out over a wall, to strengthen him.

content.hebrew: אֶל הַשֵּׁם יִתְפַּלֵּל כָּל־חָסִיד לְעֵת מְצוֹא.
content.transliteration: El hash’shem yitpallel kol ḥasid le‘et metso.
content.english: Every pious person prays to the Name at the time when [He] is found.
content.comments: The Name. An epithet for God.

content.hebrew: קהל: וּלְיוֹסֵף אָמַר: מְבֹרֶֽכֶת יוי אַרְצוֹ.   (דברים לג:יג)
content.transliteration: Ḳahal: UlYosef amar: Mevorekhet Adonai artso.
content.english: Cong. And to Joseph he said that his land was blessed by Adonai.  (Deut. 33:13)

content.hebrew: בִּנְיָמִן יְבֹרַךְ בְּשֵׁם כְּלָיוֹת חֹקֵר,
content.transliteration: Binyamin yevorakh beshem kelayot ḥoḳer,
content.english: Benjamin will be blessed in the name of the One who examines innermost thoughts,

content.hebrew: חֶבְלוֹ עַל אַדְמַת הַקֹּֽדֶשׁ לְבַקֵּר.
content.transliteration: Ḥevlo ‘al admat haḳḳodesh levaḳḳer.
content.english: Such that [He] will visit his territory of holy soil.

content.hebrew: רֹאשׁ וָסוֹף עֵינֵי אֹיְבָיו יְנַקֵּר –
content.transliteration: Rosh vasof ‘enē oyevav yenaḳḳer –
content.english: At the beginning, and at the end, he will put out the eyes of his enemies—

content.hebrew: קהל: בִּנְיָמִין זְאֵב יִטְרָף בַּבֹּֽקֶר.     (בראשית מט:כז)
content.transliteration: Ḳahal: Binyamin ze’ev yitraf babboḳer.
content.english: Cong. Benjamin is a tearing wolf in the morning.    (Gen. 49:27)

content.hebrew: עֹז לְךָ אֱלֹהִים! גַּאֲוָתְךָ עַל יִשְׂרָאֵל עַמֶּֽךָ,
content.transliteration: ‘oz lekha Elohim ga’avatekha ‘al Yisra’el ‘ammekha,
content.english: God, strength is Yours! Your pride is over Your people Israel,

content.hebrew: וְעֻזְּךָ בַּשְּׁחָקִים, שְׁמֵי שָׁמֶֽיךָ.
content.transliteration: Ve‘uzzekha bash’sheḥaḳim, shemē shamekha.
content.english: And Your strength is in the heavens, Your highest skies.

content.hebrew: גָּנוֹן וְהִצִּיל זֶֽרַע יְדִידֶֽיךָ, לְמַֽעַן רַחֲמֶֽיךָ,
content.transliteration: Ganon vehits’tsil zera‘ yedidekha, lema‘an raḥamekha,
content.english: Protect and rescue the progeny of Your dear ones, for the sake of Your mercy;

content.hebrew: קהל: אַתָּה יוי אָבִֽינוּ; גֹּאֲלֵֽנוּ מֵעוֹלָם שְׁמֶֽךָ.   (ע"פ ישעיהו סג:טז)
content.transliteration: Ḳahal: Atta Adonai avinu, go’alenu me‘olam shemekha.
content.english: Cong. You, God, are our father; You have always been our redeemer! (cf. Isa. 63:16)

content.hebrew: חזן: יֹ֭אמְר֖וּ גְּאוּלֵ֣י יו֑י אֲשֶׁ֥ר גְּ֝אָלָ֗ם מִיַּד־צָֽר: (תהלים קז:ב)
content.transliteration: Ḥazzan: Yomeru ge’ulē Adonai asher ge’alam miyyad tsar:
content.english: Cantor: Let those redeemed by Adonai say that He has redeemed them from the enemy’s hand. (Ps. 107:2)

content.hebrew: קהל: גֹּֽאֲלֵ֕נוּ יו֥י צְבָא֖וֹת שְׁמ֑וֹ קְד֖וֹשׁ יִשְׂרָאֵֽל: (ישעיה מז:ד)
content.transliteration: Ḳahal: Go’alenu Adonai tseva’ot shemo ḳedosh Yisra’el:
content.english: Congregation: Our redeemer, Adonai Ẓeva’oth is His name, the Holy One of Israel. (Isa. 47:4)
content.comments: Adonai Ẓeva’oth. A common name for God in Scripture; traditional English: “the Lord of Hosts.”
